capabilities: Pin notes and folders as shortcut cards
Customize card size, orientation, icons, and images
Reorder and nest cards via drag-and-drop
Switch themes and apply custom CSS
disambiguation: Not a quick-capture note tool; it is a startup dashboard that pins existing notes and folders as shortcut cards.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in customizable home screen for one-click access to frequently used notes and folders.
summary: Customizable home dashboard that pins notes and folders as one-click shortcut cards and opens automatically when Obsidian starts.
